paper_title: Emission of Single and Few Electrons in XENON1T and Limits on Light Dark Matter
notes: Solar dark photon limit, the paper's distinctive 'first direct limits from experimental results on solar dark photons' (Sec VI). Curve traced from fig_solar_dp_limits_errata.pdf (Fig 16 in the current arXiv v3, the erratum-corrected version used in the paper): dark navy 'XENON1T SE (This Work)' path, ε (kinetic mixing) vs m_A'. X-axis m_A' [keV/c^2] converted to eV (x1000); axes calibrated on major tick positions. 90% CL. Solar (flux-based) source, so limit is independent of local DM halo density -> dm_density_assumed null. The paper reports several other limits also in the canonical planes: relic dark-photon DM absorption (Fig 15 top, also DarkPhoton chi, but mostly non-competitive with XENON10, new space only in a narrow low-mass band) and ALP axioelectric g_ae (Fig 15 bottom, AxionElectron); plus DM-electron scattering cross-section and EFT dipole/anapole operators (not in the canonical table). Chose the solar dark photon as it is the paper's highlighted novel DarkPhoton result and a clean single curve. Curve spans ~0.01-290 eV; power-law chi ~ 1/m at low mass, bathtub minimum chi~1.9e-14 near 90 eV.
